items.title: General Mills (GIS) Seeks Bylaw Changes On Officer Liability
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE: GIS) has put forward a proposal to amend its bylaws to address officer exculpation and a federal forum selection provision at its upcoming shareholder meeting. The changes would provide certain officers with protection from monetary liability for specific fiduciary duty claims consistent with recent corporate law developments.
